super.reset.title: Start this bar again
super.reset.body: For a bar that was used for testing. Clears every record of it (sales, payments, the menu and stock, shifts and expenses, approvals, the audit log, counter phones) and everyone the owner added: counter staff, servers and managers. Managers who run no other bar lose their account. The bar, its code and its owner stay, and it opens like a new bar.
super.reset.warning: This cannot be undone. Counter phones of this bar will ask for the bar code again.
super.reset.typeName: Type the bar’s name to confirm: {name}
super.reset.wrongName: That is not the bar’s name.
super.reset.notFound: This bar is no longer there.
super.reset.done: {name} has been reset. It opens as a new bar.
